QuoteDelivery. Calls delivery-promise POST /delivery-quotes (network OHS, with the request's Idempotency-Key) synchronously and stores the returned quote: groups with their lines and offers (offerId, tier, window, expiresAt) plus the unavailable tiers. The quote holds no capacity. Publishes CartDeliveryQuoted (analytics).
